versions.content: The ComM module shall be able to distribute the status of a PNC (result of the PNC state machine) via one or more communications busses using one or more COM signals ,as a bit vector, containing a bit which represents the status of the PNC with ComMPncComSignalDirection “TX” assigned to this PNC. (For more details, refer to Figure 2: PNC State Machine)
